summary: Rewrote court.sharpe.sharpe_ratio to compute μ̂/σ̂ via mean and Bessel std only (same validation and σ̂==0 raise as before), without calling series_moments so skew/kurtosis are not computed on the PBO metric path. series_moments, DSR/PSR, judge registry, and pbo_cscv were left untouched. Added tests/test_sharpe_perf.py for bit-identity, raise preservation, PBO φ-invariance vs a local mean/std metric, and a <5s judge-driven PBO wall-time bound; added a lean-path source check in tests/test_sharpe.py. Measured PBO (T=480,N=100,n_splits=12 via judge) ≈ 2.08 s.
